title: estimate/v2 decision
description: The cost-estimate honesty schema: contract-first, ahead of spec-lane's own estimator implementation (see docs/protocols; the 'D4 estimate 正直さ schema' design note). A decision is either `predicted` (a point estimate exists) or `abstained` (it does not, and reason_codes says why) -- there is no third 'best guess anyway' state. `decision.status == "abstained"` MUST carry at least one reason_code; this is a semantic check in verify-fixtures.mjs, not something a single JSON Schema field constraint here can express (an object's own field can't conditionally require a sibling array to be non-empty). `DRIFT_WARNING` is the one reason_code that is advisory rather than abstain-forcing -- it MAY appear even when status is `predicted` (a calibrated prediction that also carries a drift warning is still a prediction, just a flagged one).

cohort.description: What this decision's comparison population is scoped to. Required in full even for an abstained decision -- several reason_codes (MODEL_GENERATION_MISMATCH, ROUTING_PROFILE_MISMATCH, TOKEN_BASIS_MISMATCH, TARGET_BASIS_UNSUPPORTED) are only meaningful if the cohort they're a mismatch against is recorded, not omitted.

excluded_by_reason.description: Map of reason label to excluded count. Left as an unconstrained object -- this repo's minimal validator subset does not support per-value schema validation of arbitrary-keyed maps, and the keys here are informational counts, not another closed set requiring enforcement.

prediction_interval.description: Whether enough calibration history (leave-one-out error samples) exists to also emit a confidence interval around the point estimate -- orthogonal to decision.status: a `predicted` decision (a point estimate exists) can still have prediction_interval.status == "insufficient_data" (not enough LOO history yet to bound it). M0 ships this schema only; the calibration math that would ever produce status == "available" is M1 work, so v2's own fixture set exercises insufficient_data exclusively (see fixtures/expected-results.json).

coverage_history.description: frozen_predictions_only is always true in v2: a prediction, once recorded, is never retroactively rewritten when later evidence arrives -- only new revisions get appended (see docs/protocols/estimate-v2.md, mirroring trace/v1's append-only supersedes model).
